annotation.title_clean: Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2017/79 establishing detailed technical requirements and test procedures for the EC type-approval of motor vehicles with respect to their 112-based eCall in-vehicle systems
annotation.title_en: Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2017/79 establishing detailed technical requirements and test procedures for the EC type-approval of motor vehicles with respect to their 112-based eCall in-vehicle systems
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union, L 12/44
annotation.summary_en: EU delegated regulation setting technical requirements and test procedures for EC type-approval of vehicles, separate technical units and components with 112-based eCall emergency call systems, covering crash resistance, audio, triggering, Galileo/EGNOS positioning, self-test and privacy. Not about AI or robotics.
key_provisions_or_claims: Type-approval requires passing crash, audio, triggering, GNSS, self-test and privacy tests in Annexes I-VIII
Exempts certain armoured vehicle classes (Annex IX)
eCall systems must not be traceable; log files deleted within 13 hours and at most three locations retained
Amends Regulation 2015/758 to update referenced EN standards
